parsed.rationale: Two unnamed extensions on SwiftUI.Image exist in separate packages — `app:WatchXYC` (WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:190) and `app:iOS` (WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift:27). Neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so consolidation is appropriate. Because the two targets are distinct app targets (watchOS vs. iOS/widget), a shared Swift package that both depend on would be the canonical home; however, if the extension bodies diverge by platform, a single file with `#if os(watchOS)` / `#if os(iOS)` guards inside a shared module is the idiomatic Swift alternative. The cluster signals a name-collision risk and potential drift between the two extension bodies over time.
